body.statement: Under the causal conditions of Wang et al., their conservative post-dropout formula has arm-specific lower endpoint \(E_{P_{\mathrm{obs}}}[\widetilde T\mid A=a,Z=z,R=r]\) and upper endpoint \(E_{P_{\mathrm{obs}}}[\widetilde T\mathbf 1\{\Delta=0\}+t_{\max}\mathbf 1\{\Delta=1\}\mid A=a,Z=z,R=r]\); the CATE lower endpoint subtracts the control-arm upper endpoint from the treated-arm lower endpoint, and the CATE upper endpoint subtracts the control-arm lower endpoint from the treated-arm upper endpoint.

source.locator: Equation (4), equation (8), and Theorem 5.1 with equation (9) in arXiv:2510.13397v3, pages 5--6 of the PDF

attestation.note: Transcribed from the displayed formulas at the cited locations in version 3 of the source PDF.
